entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, fell to 59 centimetres on 15 November from 73 centimetres on 14 November
entry.summary: The 06:15 reading is 14 centimetres lower than the day before, after a recovery from a 5 centimetre low on 8 November. Barges still load below capacity at this depth. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, Kaub readings of 14 and 15 November 2026
